name: Text Normalize
description: Normalizes text columns and keeps the original columns next to the normalized ones (or replaces them with 'replace'). Supports Unicode normalization forms NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD, accent stripping, lower/upper case, punctuation removal, whitespace collapsing and trimming. DuckDB 1.5.6 only has nfc_normalize, so NFD/NFKD/NFKC and accent stripping run in Java over the distinct values of the selected columns (bounded at 100000 distinct values; above that the node fails with a hint), and the result is joined back in SQL. The row count never enters the heap.

mode.title: Unicode normalization
mode.description: Unicode normalization form; none leaves the text as it is.

strip_accents.title: Strip accents
strip_accents.description: Remove combining marks, so Cafe becomes Cafe with plain letters.

collapse_whitespace.title: Collapse whitespace
collapse_whitespace.description: Replace every whitespace run with one space.

suffix.title: Suffix
suffix.description: Suffix of the normalized column when the original is kept.

replace.title: Replace columns
replace.description: Replace the original values instead of adding normalized columns.
